title: Psalms 134
summary: Servant - Peculiarly so called, priests and Levites. Night - Not only by day, but also by night, when their watch was more necessary. Stand - Serve or minister.

inlines.v: Servant - Peculiarly so called, priests and Levites. Night - Not only by day, but also by night, when their watch was more necessary. Stand - Serve or minister.
Thee - Thee whosoever thou art who dost faithfully perform the duty here commanded.
